NO_GLUE.description: GLUE inspection did not pass on one or both sides.
checks: Check whether glue is present on the most recently processed parts.
Check the glue machine pump.
Clean the nozzle.
Purge the glue system.
Check the moleskin on the stamping station.

NO_INNER.description: INNER inspection did not pass on one or both sides.
checks: Check the last tray for missing INNER components.
Check the gripper.
Check the fixture.

NO_NP.description: The robot reported an NP inspection NG result.
checks: Check that the nameplates are present and correctly positioned.
Review any available image of the affected parts.
Check nameplate seating and any obstruction at the inspection position.

NO_PART_FROM_CONVEYOR.description: The conveyor pickup-ready signal was not received within 150 seconds.
checks: Check the conveyor for jams.
Check whether the sensor is working correctly.

PICK_PART_NO_VAC.description: One or both vacuum sensors did not confirm the part pickup.
checks: Replace the suction cups.
Clear any blockage in the vacuum generator.
Check the tubing for air leaks.
Check whether the pickup location has shifted.

PICK_PART_WAIT_TIMEOUT.description: The part-transfer permission signals did not reach the required state within 25 seconds.
checks: Check the T6 for a fault preventing completion of NP placement.
Check whether the NP tray is ready.

DROP_PART_WAIT_TIMEOUT.description: Permission to place the parts in the fixture was not received within 25 seconds.
checks: Check the T6 for a fault after NP placement and before INNER placement is complete.
Check the feeder bowl for jams or other problems.

NP_LOCATION_INVALID.description: The nameplate pickup location number is invalid; NP_Loc must be 1 or 2.
checks: Check for an internal counter error.
Restart the machine.

PICK_NP_NO_VAC.description: One or both vacuum sensors did not confirm the nameplate pickup.
checks: Check the NP tray for missing nameplates.
Check whether the T6 pickup operation is working correctly.
Try restarting the machine.

DROP_NP_WAIT_TIMEOUT.description: Permission to place the nameplates was not received within 25 seconds.
checks: Check whether the fixture moves correctly.
Check the moleskin on the stamping station.

PICK_FIXTURE_WAIT_TIMEOUT.description: Permission to pick the assembled parts from the fixture was not received within 25 seconds.
checks: Check whether the fixture moves correctly.
Check the moleskin on the stamping station.

PICK_FIXTURE_NO_VAC.description: Vacuum was not confirmed after fixture or buffer pickup, or before pallet placement.
checks: Check whether AC is operating normally.
Check the fixture for tape residue, glue residue or foreign objects.
Check the suction cups.

PALLET_NOT_READY.description: The IsPalletOk signal remained OFF after the pallet-ready wait of up to 15 seconds.
checks: Check whether the plate is ready.
Gently push the plate to check whether the motor is enabled.

SECOND_PLACE_TIMEOUT.description: The pallet position signal (okPosition) was still OFF after the second-place reset and position waits.
checks: Check whether the plate is ready.
Gently push the plate to check whether the motor is enabled.

CALI_STOP.description: The calibration routine was entered and intentionally stopped by the robot program.
checks: Confirm whether entering the calibration routine was intentional.
Have maintenance verify the selected routine and calibration procedure.
